rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes limits of a static image, but it wavers on expansion stage (suggesting 3 vs 2) and includes some features not clearly verifiable from the image.
Integrates age, BMI, PCOS, sperm parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though AMH absence and PCOS implications are discussed somewhat broadly.
Overall logical structure, but there are internal inconsistencies in implantation estimates (45-55%, 50-65%, 45-60%) and mixed statements about embryo stage and endometrium characterization.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, caution with fresh transfer in PCOS/OHSS risk, and not routinely pushing PGT-A or add-ons in a 31-year-old first cycle.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support considerations, fresh vs freeze-all decision points, and future-cycle planning, though some advice remains general rather than protocol-specific.
